changelog: Call Coach (Hunter's 10/23 audit, every CSR): Publish waits for the AI note and checks every text for hard no's; a job at a different address needs a hand pick; a note Roofr already has is never posted twice; appointments keep their invitees and use Arizona time, and the picker only pre-picks a single upcoming Sales appointment.
Call Coach live calls: a network blip no longer drops the call audio, an update never reloads a CTM tab with a call on it, and the CSR name comes from CTM or Roofr Assist.
Answer-call shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+9 (Command+Shift+9 on a Mac) answers the ringing CTM call from anywhere.
After the update, a call that was half-confirmed in Preview & Publish asks for 'All correct' once more.
